Whether the provider supports automatic model-driven skill invocation — the model selects and activates a skill without explicit user syntax. Implementations vary: description-field semantic matching, explicit keyword arrays, and boolean flags are all equivalent mechanisms for the same concept. Note: a description field paired with an opt-out disable_model_invocation flag is functionally equivalent to an explicit auto_invocable boolean — both express that the skill participates in automatic activation unless suppressed.
key.spec_ref: ACIF-SKILL §10.1 (DERIVABLE); activation enum ACIF-SKILL §6.2, Appendix A

auto_invocable.mechanism: the agent sees a catalog of installed skills (name + description) and auto-invokes the one whose description matches the task; opt out via disable-model-invocation

key.description: The required or conventional filename for this skill type. For example, "SKILL.md" for Claude Code skills.

canonical_filename.mechanism: SKILL.md is the required fixed filename inside each skill folder (YAML frontmatter + Markdown body)

key.description: What the skill does. Used by the AI to decide when to auto-invoke it. Also shown in skill listings and help text.

description.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: description (required); the agent uses it to decide when to auto-invoke; keep under 1024 bytes

key.description: When true, the AI cannot auto-invoke this skill; only the user can invoke it explicitly. Default: false.
key.spec_ref: ACIF-SKILL §10.1 (DERIVABLE); activation enum ACIF-SKILL §6.2, Appendix A

disable_model_invocation.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: disable-model-invocation (optional bool, default false); hides the skill from the autonomous catalog while leaving it slash/@-invocable

key.description: Human-readable display name for the skill. If omitted, the directory name is used. Shown in skill listings and menus.

display_name.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required); lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens, 1-64 chars, should match the skill folder name and doubles as the identifier

key.description: Whether the skill can be installed at global/personal scope (applies across all projects for the current user).

global_scope.mechanism: global skills live in ~/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and apply to every project

key.description: Whether the skill can be installed at project scope (applies to current project only, typically committed to version control).

project_scope.mechanism: project-local skills live in <worktree>/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and load only from trusted worktrees

key.description: Whether the skill directory may contain arbitrary co-located files (scripts, templates, configs, checklists) beyond SKILL.md that the agent can access when the skill is invoked. Enables multi-file skill bundles without converting supporting files into separate skills or rules.

skill_bundled_resources.mechanism: a skill folder may co-locate scripts/, references/, and assets/ subfolders that the agent loads on demand via read_file/list_directory

key.description: When false, the skill is hidden from user-facing menus (e.g., the / command menu). The AI can still invoke it. Default: true.

user_invocable.mechanism: skills are user-invocable via / slash command or @skill mention, injecting the skill instructions as context (shown as a crease button)
